schema.evidence: All 15 expected columns are present with standard, uniform datatypes. Zero type corruption or schema drift observed.

temporal_structure.evidence: Complete calendar coverage from 2015-01-01 to 2025-02-10 (3,694 consecutive calendar days, zero missing calendar days). However, daily station sampling density underwent a major regime shift in Jan 2021 (jumping from ~170 to ~410 stations/day).

geographic_information.evidence: 406 unique stations across all Indian states and UTs. Zero coordinates out of India's bounding box. Elevations match physical topography.

station_identity.evidence: 7 station names map to distinct physical coordinates/elevations. Requires composite station_id before grouping.

missingness.evidence: Extreme historical missingness in wind (68-89%), pressure (69-97%), and rainfall (66-70%) during 2015-2020. Near-zero missingness (<1% across all variables) during 2021-2025. Multivariate ML must be conditioned on modern temporal partition.

rainfall_quality.evidence: 26.5% missing, 37.7% zero, 35.7% positive. No negative rainfall. Must keep missing and zero strictly separated.

measurement_validity.evidence: Fewer than 100 anomalous temperature records (<0.01% of dataset). Wind and pressure values are physically valid.

historical_analytics.evidence: Long-term temperature, seasonal climatology, and state comparisons are fully supported across all 10 years.

forecasting_suitability.target_a_temperature: READY_WITH_CONDITIONS (High feasibility with chronological split and station lag tracking)
forecasting_suitability.target_b_rainfall_amount: READY_WITH_CONDITIONS (High skewness and zero inflation require specialized two-stage or Tweedie objective)
forecasting_suitability.target_c_rain_binary: READY (Balanced positive vs zero distribution in non-null observations; standard classification)

future_ml_preparation.evidence: Feasible after implementing composite station keys, dual-regime partitioning, and walk-forward CV splits.
